entities.summary: Corey Michael Linsley is an American former professional football player who was a center in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ohio State Buckeyes. Linsley was selected by the Green Bay Packers in the fifth round of the 2014 NFL draft, and has also played in the National Football League (NFL) for the Los Angeles Chargers.
